# Xiaomie Magic Tools (小咩魔法系列软件)

> Official suite of AI productivity tools for cross-border e-commerce sellers.

## Core Products
- **Xiaomie Magic Collector (小咩魔法采集)**: https://xiaomie.tools/collector/ (Download: https://collector.xiaomie.tools/%E5%B0%8F%E5%92%A9%E9%AD%94%E6%B3%95%E9%87%87%E9%9B%86-chrome-v1.0.8.zip)
- **Xiaomie Magic Carousel (小咩魔法轮播视频)**: https://xiaomie.tools/carousel/ (Studio: https://carousel.xiaomie.tools/)

## Shared Infrastructure
- **API Endpoint**: https://api.xiaomie.tools (isolated by `app_id`)
